module_summary: Serial byte receiver: a 12-state FSM tracks start, 8 data bits and stop bit while a 10-bit shift register captures the bits; done marks a valid byte.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Receiver FSM register sequencing START, B0-B7, STOP, DONE, ERR states

anchors.name: byte_r
anchors.why: 10-bit shift register shifting in serial bits LSB first

anchors.name: out_byte
anchors.why: Received byte output, taken from shift register bits 8:1 when done

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse in DONE state marking out_byte valid

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Serial input bit stream feeding shift register and FSM start/stop checks

groups.name: rx_fsm
groups.description: Detects start bit, counts 8 data bits, verifies stop bit, handles error wait

groups.name: rx_shift
groups.description: Shift register deserializing serial input into the output byte
